blocks.x: How Applied AI & GenAI lands in Fashion & Luxury — the constraints that shape the build, the gated delivery pattern, and the deltas we commit against your baseline.

Fashion and luxury sell scarcity, story and service: assortment risk (the size-curve problem), authenticity, clienteling quality and channel consistency. Technology must be invisible — but the intelligence beneath it decides which drops pay.

items: High-value client service depends on associate memory; digital channels generic.
Assortment and buy decisions guess curves; end-of-season markdowns absorb the error.

At Retail & Consumer Goods level this capability reads as: product copy and campaign variants generated under brand guardrails with approval flows (campaign production time down 50%). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

This capability runs on the cadence set out below; the rhythm is fixed, the scope is signed. The first quarter of the rhythm is verification: weeks 1–2 measure the current metric with your team and lock it by signature. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with your control owner receiving evidence weekly. Weeks 9–12 industrialize: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and the measured delta against the signed baseline. Gates are binding: miss one and the program stops or redirects with a documented decision.
